name: REST GET
description: Fetch data: request params built from the pasted OpenAPI parameters; 4xx -> BPMN error HTTP_<status>.

properties.label: URL
properties.description: Request URL. Supports ${expressions} and {placeholders} that are filled from params with "x-in": "path". Example: ${apiBaseUrl}/users/{userId}

properties.label: Sources
properties.description: Comma separated process variable names (or a JSON literal) deep-merged in order - later wins. Example: currentUser, userChanges

properties.label: Params schema
properties.description: Paste the operation's "parameters" list from the service's OpenAPI / Swagger document (in: path | query | header). A parameter is filled from the merged sources, else from the process variable with the same name. Paste it as JSON or YAML (OpenAPI 3.x or Swagger 2.0); "$ref"s must resolve inside the pasted text, so paste the referenced components too, or the whole document plus a top-level "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Name". Add "x-source": "/json/pointer" or "x-expression": "varName" (no dollar-brace wrapper) where your process data is named differently. Long pastes (a whole OpenAPI document) work with history level activity or none; with audit / full history the engine stores every input in history and limits it to 4000 characters.

pattern.message: Must be OpenAPI / JSON Schema as JSON or YAML

properties.label: Static headers
properties.description: JSON object, values may use ${expressions}. Example: {"X-Correlation-Id": "${execution.processInstanceId}"}

properties.label: Response schema
properties.description: Optional. Paste the response schema from the service's OpenAPI / Swagger document: a schema object, a response, or the operation's "responses" (the first 2xx is used). Shapes the response (only declared properties are kept, writeOnly ones dropped) and validates it. Violation -> BPMN error RESPONSE_INVALID. Paste it as JSON or YAML (OpenAPI 3.x or Swagger 2.0); "$ref"s must resolve inside the pasted text, so paste the referenced components too, or the whole document plus a top-level "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Name". Add "x-source": "/json/pointer" or "x-expression": "varName" (no dollar-brace wrapper) where your process data is named differently. Long pastes (a whole OpenAPI document) work with history level activity or none; with audit / full history the engine stores every input in history and limits it to 4000 characters.

pattern.message: Must be OpenAPI / JSON Schema as JSON or YAML

properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: Process variable receiving the response body (stored as JSON).

pattern.message: Must be a valid variable name

properties.label: Status variable
properties.description: Process variable receiving the HTTP status code.

pattern.message: Must be a valid variable name

properties.label: Technical errors (5xx, timeout, connection)
properties.description: exception (default): the task fails - incident, or retried with async before. bpmnError: thrown as BPMN error HTTP_5xx / CONNECTION_FAILED so an error boundary event or error event subprocess can handle it. 4xx (HTTP_4xx) and schema errors (REQUEST_INVALID / RESPONSE_INVALID) are always BPMN errors.

properties.label: Mock enabled
properties.description: Test mode: true = do not send the request, answer with Mock status / Mock response instead (the request is still built and validated, the response schema, error mapping and result variables work as for a real call). false or empty = real call. An expression switches it per instance, e.g. ${execution.getVariable('useMockData') == true}.

pattern.message: true, false or an expression ${...}

properties.label: Mock status
properties.description: HTTP status the mock answers with (default 200). A 4xx / 5xx tests the error handling, e.g. 404 -> BPMN error HTTP_404.

pattern.message: An HTTP status, e.g. 200

properties.label: Mock response
properties.description: Response body the mock answers with: a JSON object / array (or text); empty = no body. ${expressions} inside are evaluated by the engine, so the mock can echo process variables.

properties.label: Async before (enables job retries on 5xx / timeouts)
